photos.llama_desc: Three children and one adult watching a screen in a children's play area. The screen shows a cartoon character on a rainbow-colored background with a question "What goes on top?" and a cartoon character with wings. The children are standing in front of a large, round, white and red play structure with a screen in the center.

A group of children and adults playing soccer on a grassy field. The children are running and chasing each other, some of them wearing soccer jerseys and cleats. A few adults are standing on the sidelines, watching and coaching.

A woman and a large number of gifts in various sizes and shapes, including several large boxes, wrapped in colorful paper and decorated with ribbons and bows, are arranged on a table in a room with a brown wall and a hardwood floor.

Five people, including a woman and four children, gather around a table with a lit birthday cake. The woman, wearing a black shirt with a white logo, is surrounded by the children, who are all smiling and looking at the camera. The table is set with a white tablecloth and a single candle on a slice of cake.

Five children and one adult standing in front of a yellow school bus. The children are wearing paper crowns with leaves and flowers, and they are smiling and looking at the camera. The adult is standing behind them, holding a camera and smiling.

Five people, including two children and three adults, pose in front of a green railing, surrounded by a variety of flowers and plants. The children are dressed in Easter-themed outfits, with the girl wearing a pink and white dress and the boy wearing a pink shirt and white pants. The adults are wearing Easter-themed clothing, with one woman wearing a pink and white dress and another woman wearing a green and white dress.

A person sitting at a table with a sandwich and a pair of sunglasses. The person is wearing a white baseball cap with a black logo on the front, a blue and yellow shirt with a pattern of small flowers, and is sitting with their back to the camera. The table is made of dark wood and has a brown and white checkered paper liner.

Eight people, including two adults and six children, are standing together in a bowling alley. The group is standing in front of a row of bowling lanes, with the bright yellow and red lights of the bowling equipment and the colorful decorations of the bowling alley's walls and floor visible in the background.
A child and one adult holding the Stanley Cup. The child is standing on a white platform, holding the cup above her head with both hands. The adult is standing behind her, holding her up.
A young girl with a birthday crown and a chocolate cake with candles in a dining room.
